GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward; settled off midfield. Slow to begin. When qst, rdr std intention was to settle in a more forward position, but after placing mnt under pressure in early stages, it attempted to buck & became very awkward, & as result he had to restrain & settle towards rear of field. Std mnt then raced very keenly throughout mid stages & when placed under pressure rounding h/turn it gave limited response so he elected to not ride it out over the final 200m. A post-race vet exam rev a slow recovery. Tnr was told the gelding must trial before racing again. Since passed trial.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden more conservatively from the outside barrier; settled midfield. Passing the 200m was steadied and directed in and away from  heels. When questioned, rdr std although the gelding raced wide through the early and middle stages it always had cover. Std mnt was one paced when under pressure in the straight and was disappointing, and in his opinion would be better suited over a longer distance. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr subsequently reported satisfaction with the post-race condition of the gelding and added it would take benefit from its first-up run. .
